meta.title: Check-Di · Multi-stage Supply Chain Traceability
meta.description: Check-Di tracks the product journey from origin to retail using timelines, QR codes, AI document cross-checking, and hash-based integrity proofs.

hero.description: Track every handoff, document and confirming organization in one product journey — from farm to retail.
hero.mobileDescription: See the journey, documents and confirming parties.
hero.mobileScanHint: Open the full journey in one scan.
hero.routeSummary: Journey from Long An to Ho Chi Minh City

gettingStarted.tourWelcomeText: Here is a quick tour of the key actions. It only appears for new visitors, and you can skip it at any time.

tourSteps.title: Sign in and link your wallet
tourSteps.text: If you represent an organization, start here to sign in and link Phantom for confirmation signatures.

tourSteps.title: Create a product batch
tourSteps.text: Once inside your organization, create a batch and add each stage, document and related data.

tourSteps.title: Try product verification
tourSteps.text: If you only want to verify provenance, use this button to explore the public QR journey without an account.

coreFlow.title: One QR. The whole journey.
coreFlow.description: Each participant records the stage they own. Check-Di links those handoffs into one verifiable trace.
coreFlow.sourceVisualTitle: From the farm to every handoff
coreFlow.sourceVisualText: Each participant only records the stage they are responsible for.
coreFlow.resultText: Timeline, documents, confirming parties and proof.

steps.title: Record at the source
steps.text: Growers or operators add the stage data and supporting documents.

steps.title: AI checks the data
steps.text: Cross-check batch IDs, dates, quantities and highlight mismatches.

steps.title: Confirm & hash
steps.text: The organization signs its stage and creates an integrity record.

steps.title: Consumers scan QR
steps.text: Review the journey, confirming parties and public proof.

sandbox.title: Track a batch just like an active delivery.
sandbox.description: The map pinpoints where the batch is currently located; click any checkpoint to inspect the organization, timestamp, attached documents, AI check results, and cryptographic hash.

dualTrack.badge: One QR Code · Shared Stakeholder Accountability
dualTrack.title: No single party controls the entire narrative.
dualTrack.description: Each organization only confirms data for its own segment of the chain. Check-Di links these checkpoints into a verifiable timeline for consumers.

groups.title: Producers / Orchards
groups.text: Initialize batch records, register harvest parameters, and attach origin certificates.

groups.title: Packaging & Quality Control
groups.text: Append inspection certificates, grading results, and sign off on processed quantities.

groups.title: Logistics & Warehousing
groups.text: Log dispatch and delivery timestamps, route conditions, and custody handoffs.

groups.title: Retailers & Consumers
groups.text: Retailers confirm stock arrival; shoppers scan QR codes to inspect the full authentic journey.

dualTrack.competitionBanner: For UniHackFest, Technical Build proves AI document verification + hash integrity + QR scanning + Solana anchoring; Product & Business demonstrates real-world supply chain feasibility and stakeholder adoption. Both tracks share the same Check-Di core.

architecture.title: Records stay off-chain. Proof stays on-chain.
architecture.description: Detailed documents remain private; blockchain only keeps the minimum data needed for verification.
architecture.demoDisclaimer: The sample batch uses simulated data; Devnet proof only appears when a real transaction exists.
architecture.offChainText: Documents, photos and operational data stay off-chain.
architecture.onChainText: Hash, signer, version, timestamp and status.
architecture.immutabilityText: History is never overwritten; changes create a new record.
architecture.registryText: Program + PDA proofs can be verified publicly.

compliance.title: Transparent integrity without crypto speculation.
compliance.description: Check-Di uses blockchain strictly as an integrity proof layer, not as a financial trading system.
rules: No raw or confidential documents stored on-chain
No tokens, no speculative investments, no crypto payments
AI highlights discrepancies without making automated fraud verdicts
Each party only verifies records within their direct custody
